LAKE WALES, Fla., Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (

)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—announced that Belle Lago, a new Century Complete community in Lake Wales, Florida, will release new homes for sale in mid-November, offering one- and two-story floor plans with limited lakeview homesites, starting from the low $300s.

"Belle Lago is a place where a beautiful setting doesn't have to feel out of reach. This community offers attainably priced new construction homes, some with lake views, within about an hour's reach of Orlando and Tampa," said Justin Laloggia, Regional Vice President of Sales. "Floor plans at the community also offer flex space that can adapt to homebuyer needs, with select plans offering up to 3-car garages. Homebuyers interested in learning more about this community should register for the upcoming Belle Lago Insider Virtual Event on November 2."

Across seven floor plans, homebuyers will find room to make Belle Lago their own. One- and two-story homes offer open-concept layouts and flexible living spaces like studies and gamerooms, as well as covered patios (select plans). Homes also come standard with quality features such as quartz countertops, LG® stainless-steel appliances, and Kohler® fixtures.

Beyond the front door, Lake Wales, known as the Crown Jewel of the Ridge, blends small-town charm and natural beauty with modern convenience. Historic Downtown Lake Wales and the renowned Bok Tower Gardens are within minutes, and downtown Orlando and Tampa are about an hour away, along with major attractions such as Walt Disney World, SeaWorld and Universal Studios.

US-27 and connecting highways link Lake Wales to Lakeland and Winter Haven—home to LEGOLAND Florida Resort. To the north, Polk County's logistics and distribution corridor offers employment opportunities with Amazon, Saddle Creek Logistics, Walmart, and more.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Question:
Where is Belle Lago located?
Answer:

Belle Lago is a Century Complete community offering new homes in Lake Wales, Florida. The community is located minutes from Bok Tower Gardens and Historic Downtown Lake Wales, and about an hour from downtown Orlando, downtown Tampa, Walt Disney World, Universal Studios, and SeaWorld. The community address is 2080 Skye Way, Lake Wales, FL 33853.
Question:
What floor plans will Belle Lago offer?
Answer:

Belle Lago in Lake Wales, Florida, will offer seven one- and two-story floor plans up to 2,467 square feet, with 4 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 3.5 bathrooms, and 2- to 3-car garages. A model home is projected to open in December 2026.
Question:
Does Belle Lago have CDD fees?
Answer:
No, Belle Lago in Lake Wales, Florida, has no Community Development District (CDD) fees.
Question:
How can homebuyers learn more about Belle Lago?
Answer:
Homebuyers can register for the Belle Lago Insider Virtual Event on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. ET, for information about homesite releases, location, floor plan pricing, and more.
